exact: ent-kaurene oxidation to kaurenoic acid by ent-kaurene oxidase

definition: The three successive oxidations of the 4-methyl group of ent-kaurene to form ent-kaur-16-en-19-oate, kaurenoic acid. This process may be carried out entirely by the enzyme ent-kaurene oxidase.
label: ent-kaurene oxidation to kaurenoic acid
